mainEntity.name: How do pool bubblers compare to deck jets or waterfalls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pool bubblers create a soft, upward stream directly from within the pool, ideal for shallow areas like Baja shelves, offering a more intimate water feature. Deck jets shoot thin streams of water into the pool from the deck, providing dynamic arcs. Waterfalls create a larger, cascading flow, often from a raised feature. Each offers a distinct aesthetic and sound; bubblers are typically chosen for their subtle elegance and tranquil effect.
